BiblicalUsage: Scripture uses gôʼel where we would say to defile, defilement. In Nehemiah 13:29, the text says "because they have defiled the priesthood."
TheologicalSignificance: In gôʼel I find no hidden theology; it simply means to defile, defilement.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
